_notes: Poll targets for LGE 2026 (4 Nov 2026). Shares in percent of valid votes for named parties.
Party OTH (independents/local parties) is NOT taken from polls: polls under-measure local parties, so OTH comes from the structural model.
national: simple average of fieldwork Jul-Oct 2026 (SRF/Common Sense Sep-Oct & Jul, SABI/News24 Aug-Sep, Ipsos Jun-Jul).
metros: averages of Aug-Oct 2026 polls; 'weight' is how far the metro forecast moves from the model toward the polls (0-1).
Source: Wikipedia 'Opinion polling' tables for the 2026 South African municipal elections, Daily Maverick 13 Sep 2026.

JHB.polls: SRF Sep-Oct, SABI Aug-Sep, MarkData Aug-Sep

TSH.polls: SRF Sep-Oct, MarkData Aug-Sep, SABI Aug-Sep

ETH.polls: SRF Sep-Oct, SABI Aug-Sep, MarkData Aug-Sep
